build.summary:
EV110 is built, gated and deployed as P:/Mods/@DayZ_Baltic_EV110_LatticeShoresV1/Addons. narva_trial.pbo has sha 226932e3d9346e322b86f5e04958492fe1f417b958e44a3038d7516f051fbb8d and baltic_water_v30.pbo has sha 46e63c70e60a2775781bb5c7b75fa000c2c2897f0712954c06b14b2149c358db. Against the EV95 base (f1a148ca…) exactly 41 entries change: baltic_trial.wrp plus the 40 layer PAAs of the surface patch. The final terrain is ev110/terrain-ev110.npz, sha d25e9428ed39cebcef0c3b3885e23d8e397b67261846775ecdbc238fdde520e6. The compiled WRP entry has sha 792740974101326fbcbd216190f4fcc828e6a1af1b59b30cb8926af2b8929dda.

Gates on this chain:
- Kit: G2–G6 PASS. The fixed G7 also passes on the final terrain.
- Bridges v5: G1, G3, G4, G6, G7 and G8 PASS. G2 (wood ramp air) and G5 (the inherited v4 corridor) FAIL, as expected. All 22 negative controls FAIL and are detected.
- Shores: G1–G7 PASS, including G6 with 14 negative controls, and the tool checks PASS. 154 of 329 stretches are treated. On the islet, 6 of 7 stretches are treated; stretch 313 is rejected after all 7 variants (wiggle p90 0.102 > 0.080).
- Water: verify_pond_exact PASS (760,020 half-cells, 0 missing, duplicated or outside).
- Surface: G1–G5 PASS, bound to the trusted terrain/WRP pair. The binding controls behave as intended: the original EV109 trial passes, and both the retarget case and a package with the wrong WRP fail.

The gate fixes of step 11 are done. Each new negative control fails with the fixed gate and passes with the original one (shown on the reviewers' fixtures).

The server probe was not run: points.csv has 2,881 points (836 bridges + 1,945 kit + 100 shores), and split_log.py maps the probe log back to each family's ids.

One deviation: the staged records also include the pilot bridge 015-15 (bridges/records.json), as in the HANDOFF recipe. The terrain has carried its channel cut since EV107, so without it the cut would have no bridge.

There is a new finding: 2 surface cells away from any bridge, at (4779,5517) and (4755,5475), lose road paint because the shore pass lowered reserve-only vertices at the old sea crossing by more than 0.5 m.

Full log: E:/DayZ-Baltic-Build/v31-pond-layer-20261013/ev110/BUILD-EV110.md (sha 10109702…).

open_issues: No engine verification: the server probe has not been run. Kit G8 is NOT_RUN, and engine water at lips and joints, bridge continuity and the shore wet/dry pairs are unmeasured.
Bridges G2 (wood ramp air 0.86–2.31 m; the deck-flush proposal is pending) and G5 (29 inherited v4 corridor vertices) still FAIL. They need Guillermo's decision.

Deviation: the records include the pilot bridge 015-15 (bridges/records.json, as in the HANDOFF recipe), because the terrain has carried its cut since EV107. The task text named only the kit and EV110 bridge records.

The surface patch removes road paint in 2 cells away from any bridge, at (4779,5517) and (4755,5475): sea-edge reserve-only vertices moved more than 0.5 m by shore stretches 122 and 83 at the old EV96 sea crossing. Measured, not seen in game.
shore_ramp_v31.validate (production) still compares closed-chain counts only; just the gate G2 now checks spatial identity.
Bridges G7: the escapes found by the reviewer with an underestimated opening or air in the report (-1000) are still open; they were out of this task's scope.

The fixed kit, shore and surface gates live in the scratchpad (ev110-build/kit-gates, shore-gates, surface-gates), with a copy in E:/…/ev110/scripts. Only the bridge gates were changed in the worktree. Nothing committed; HANDOFF.md not updated.
texHeaders.bin is not regenerated (stale since B). Islet stretch 313 remains rejected (wiggle p90 0.102 > 0.080).

Puentes G2/G5 reejecutados: reproducen exactamente los FAIL autorizados, 14 extremos de madera con aire y 29 vértices congelados heredados. No aparecen discrepancias nuevas frente a los resultados originales.

Orillas G2/G4 reejecutados: PASS, 154 tramos aceptados, incluidos seis de la isla; 82 componentes de mar antes/después, sin creaciones, eliminaciones, divisiones o fusiones. Comparación del terreno final: cero cambios de orillas dentro de las máscaras del kit/puentes y sus halos de un vértice.

Surface G2 reejecutado: PASS sobre 147 celdas y 20 tiles; ambos positivos pasan y los tres negativos fallan. Los 12 resultados comparados coinciden con los originales salvo rutas de salida. La excepción inicial de ImageToPAA por ruta larga se resolvió usando la ruta corta del mismo archivo; predicados intactos. Evidencia: gate-agreement.json y verifier-path-adaptations.diff.
